summary.value: Unarmed strikes deal +(6 + SL × 2) damage and gain +(SL) Accuracy, but refuse extra damage from Quirks.

system.description: Unarmed strikes deal +(6 + SL × 2) damage and gain +(SL) Accuracy, but refuse extra damage from Quirks. Start of each conflict turn: declare them a different weapon Category until your next turn — bow, firearm or thrown makes them ranged.
